findings.note:
DESK #154 (owner 2026-09-12: "while panache is on, EVERY Speed gets the +10 status bonus in place of the +5; back to +5 when panache ends"). THREE RECORDS, ONE BONUS. The engine half shipped with this spec and is NOT a row: the existing `whileActive[]` carrier (src/rules/types.ts, read by activeStateGrants) gained the same three fields the standing lane already uses - landSpeedBonus / speedBonusType / speedBonusAllSpeeds - and src/rules/derive.ts deriveSpeeds pushes the ACTIVE clauses through the same `pushSpeedBonus`, so the with-panache value competes by TYPE in `stackSpeedBonuses` (highest status wins) and REPLACES the without-panache half instead of adding to it, and rides the batch-037 `allSpeedsBonus` loop for every non-land Speed the character already has. No new field name, no new loop, no second carrier.

MEASURED BEFORE (human swashbuckler, land 25 + a fly 25, npx jiti over test/_content): L1 25/25 both ways; L3 30/25 both ways; L7 30/25 both ways; L8 30/25 both ways; L11 35/25; L19 40/25 - panache changed NOTHING at any level and no fly Speed ever moved. A fighter with Swashbuckler Dedication + Swashbuckler's Speed at L8 read 30/30 with and without panache. AFTER these rows: L1 25/25 -> 30/30; L3 30/25 -> 35/35; L7 and L8 30/25 -> 40/40; L11 35/25 -> 45/45; L19 40/25 -> 55/55; the archetype fighter 30/30 -> 35/35.

THE ONE READING CHOICE, STATED: the WITHOUT-panache half stays LAND-ONLY, i.e. the shipped `landSpeedBonus` formula on vivacious-speed is left exactly as it is and gains no speedBonusAllSpeeds. class-feature-1017 prints "you still get half this status bonus to your Speed" - singular - where both of its other clauses say "Speeds", and the owner's note says to apply the half the way the app already does unless the plural is the only honest reading. It is not. Consequence on the sheet: a 7th-level swashbuckler without panache reads land 30 / fly 25, and with panache land 40 / fly 40 - land carries both status bonuses and takes the higher, the fly Speed carries only the panache one.

NO `supersedes` ON ANY ROW: the overlay's existing rows for these records are classFeatures/vivacious-speed.landSpeedBonus, classFeatures/vivacious-speed.speedBonusType, feats/swashbucklers-speed.landSpeedBonus / .speedBonusType / .speedBonusAllSpeeds / .description. All three rows below write the field `whileActive`, which no overlay row holds, so the applier's refusal 1 does not fire and declaring the flag would be refused as a flag with no key.

DELIBERATELY NOT AUTHORED: (a) no top-level `landSpeedBonus` on stylish-combatant - its clause is panache-only, and test/vivacious-speed-floor.test.ts pins that record's top-level landSpeedBonus as undefined because a conditional bonus is not an always-on number; (b) no `minLevel` on the vivacious-speed clause - the class grants that feature at 3rd, so ownedFeatureIds already gates it (measured: no bonus at L1/L2); (c) no change to stateGrantSummary / the Panache rail card - the three speed stars in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts are the existing "what will toggling panache give you" surface and a second line would be two carriers for one clause.

BLAST RADIUS, MEASURED: test/senses-supersede.test.ts:93 asserts stateGrantSummary(swashbuckler L5, 'panache') === [] and will return ONE entry (Vivacious Speed) the moment these rows land - it must become "the Panache card names the Speed bonus" in the same commit. And the vivacious-speed / swashbucklers-speed speed stars will then restate a number the sheet moves while panache is on; their wording is an open item for the desk, recorded in the batch report rather than edited here (src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts is generated by scripts/apply-situational-lane.mjs and test/vivacious-speed-floor.test.ts pins two of the strings).

backfillRows.why: AoN class-feature-1007 (Player Core 2, swashbuckler): "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with the bravado trait while in a combat encounter. While you have panache, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds." The record carried NOTHING for the second sentence - measured, a 1st-level swashbuckler read land 25 / fly 25 with panache on and with it off - so the whole clause was a star in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts and no number ever moved. `state: 'panache'` is the toggle the sheet already tracks (character.classResources.panache, the Panache card on the vitals rail); `speedBonusType: 'status'` is the printed type, which is what makes Vivacious Speed's larger bonus REPLACE this one rather than add to it; `speedBonusAllSpeeds: true` is the printed plural "to your Speeds". Owner ruling 2026-09-12 #154.

AoN class-feature-1017 (Player Core 2, swashbuckler 3rd): "When you've made an impression, you move even faster than normal, darting about the battlefield with incredible speed. Increase the status bonus to your Speeds from stylish combatant to a +10-foot status bonus; this bonus increases by 5 feet at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels. When you don't have panache, you still get half this status bonus to your Speed, rounded down to the nearest 5-foot increment." The record shipped ONLY the halved without-panache value, and only on land (landSpeedBonus "5+5*min(2,floor((@actor.level-3)/8))", speedBonusType status) - the WITH-panache value the sentence is actually about had no carrier at all. The formula here is the printed ladder itself: 10 at 3rd, +5 at each of 7th/11th/15th/19th, so min(4,floor((@actor.level-3)/4)) counts the thresholds reached and caps at four - 10 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 for levels 3-6 / 7-10 / 11-14 / 15-18 / 19-20. Halving it and rounding down to a 5-foot step reproduces the shipped standing formula exactly (5/5/10/10/15), which is the arithmetic check that the two halves are one bonus and not two. Same `status` type as the standing half, so a swashbuckler with panache gets the larger number, never their sum; same type again as feats/swashbucklers-speed, so an archetype feat can never stack on top of the class feature. Owner ruling 2026-09-12 #154.

AoN feat-6238 (Player Core 2 p.182, swashbuckler archetype, 8th): "You move with a swashbuckler's speed and grace. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds; this increases to a +10-foot status bonus while you have panache." Batch 037 authored the always-on half (landSpeedBonus 5, speedBonusType status, speedBonusAllSpeeds true) and left the panache step as a star; measured, a fighter holding Swashbuckler Dedication and this feat read land 30 / fly 30 whether panache was on or off. NO level scaling on this record - the printed sentence names none - so the value is the flat 10, not a formula. Because it is the same `status` type as the +5 beside it, the with-panache value replaces rather than adds (30 -> 35 on a 25-foot Speed, not 40), which is the whole reason the type is on both. Owner ruling 2026-09-12 #154.
